symptoms: LEMON criteria: Look externally, Evaluate 3-3-2, Mallampati, Obstruction, Neck mobility

management_steps.action: Plan A -> Plan B -> Exit Strategy Execution
management_steps.details: Plan A: Direct/Video Laryngoscopy. Plan B: Supraglottic Airway Device (SGA/LMA). Exit Strategy: Surgical Airway.

1. 4cm vertical midline skin incision.
2. Stab incision through cricothyroid membrane.
3. Insert little finger/bougie.
4. Railroad size 6.0 ETT or tracheostomy tube.

warnings: Failed airway: Call for senior help immediately upon Plan A failure.
